title: Statewide shutdown disrupts life in Manipur

ai.summary: A 24-hour statewide general strike in Manipur, called by the Native People’s Committee, Manipur (NPCM), disrupted businesses and markets in protest against the New Heaven ambush that killed four Tangkhul Naga civilians.

facts.quote: A 24-hour statewide general strike called by the Native People’s Committee, Manipur (NPCM)
brought businesses, markets and vehicular movement to a near standstill

facts.claim: protest against the New Heaven ambush that killed four Tangkhul Naga civilians
facts.quote: in protest against the recent New Heaven ambush that killed four Tangkhul Naga civilians

ai.background_note: The strike was called in response to the New Heaven ambush that killed four Tangkhul Naga civilians, demanding immediate justice for the victims.
